resources.string: No channels to show. Check the TV is online, then choose Refresh, or pick some lists in Settings.
Some channel lists couldn\'t be updated:\n%1$s
OK: watch / open · Hold OK: favourite · Guide: TV guide · CH+/−: jump a page · Back: up a level
This channel refused to play. It may be offline or only available in another country.
The channel\'s server isn\'t responding. Try another channel.
This channel uses a format the player can\'t show.
This channel couldn\'t be played. Try another channel.
The TV guide hasn\'t been set up for this copy of ChannelBox. See the README for the one-time GitHub step.
The TV guide couldn\'t be downloaded. If you\'ve only just set it up, the first guide can take up to an hour to appear. Choose Refresh to try again.
There\'s no channel %1$d in this list
Channel name, e.g. news or Bloomberg
Press OK on the box above to type, or use the microphone button on the on-screen keyboard.
No working channels here right now.
Include free channels from iptv-org (about 10,000 worldwide)
Pick the countries to show. Fewer countries means a tidier list and faster checking.
Pick at least one country, or tick Every country
Hide channels that aren\'t working (checked automatically every few hours)

Paste an M3U or M3U8 link you\'re entitled to use. Its channels appear first, and if it includes a TV guide link that\'s used too. Tip: the Google TV app on your phone lets you type with your phone\'s keyboard.
The link should start with http:// or https://
Turn on the free channels or add your own playlist link
